hotel_1star_proxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Budapest? Hotel Prices for Budapest, Hungary | Budget Your Trip
hotel_1star_proxy.evidenceText: Search snippet for the exact Budapest hotel page reports: 'After an analysis of 234 excellent hotels, $81 is the average price for the great 1-star hotels in Budapest, and the median price is $67.' It identifies the 1-star section as the average price for one night and the page states that hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes.
hotel_1star_proxy.taxEvidence: The same search snippet states: '(All hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes, and come from a base price that is reported by Kayak.)' The star-rating summary also says prices are before taxes and fees.
hotel_1star_proxy.referencePeriod: Search result crawled 3 weeks ago; search-snippet evidence only, no page read.
hotel_1star_proxy.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com/hotels Budapest Hungary 1-star hotel average price one night before taxes
hotel_1star_proxy.reason: Labelled source-level proxy candidate only: exact-city one-star USD one-night statistic and tax basis in the first snippet, paired with same-source exact-city double-occupancy wording in the second snippet. Search snippets are weaker than page evidence; never treat as observed or map/fit.

double_occupancy_semantics.sourceTitle: Budapest Travel Cost - Average Price of a Vacation to Budapest: Food & Meal Budget, Daily & Weekly Expenses | BudgetYourTrip.com
double_occupancy_semantics.evidenceText: Search snippet for the exact Budapest destination page states: 'The average price paid in Budapest for two people for a typical double-occupancy hotel room is $127 (Ft38,827).' It identifies the one-person sharing-room value as $63 per night and says these costs are from reported spending of actual travelers.
double_occupancy_semantics.occupancyEvidence: Explicit search-snippet wording names two people and a typical double-occupancy hotel room.
